headline: Developer designs AI coding framework with Claude's help
summary: A developer created a context framework for AI coding with Claude's assistance, improving efficiency and reducing errors.
details: The framework helps reduce manual steps in AI coding, improving quality and speed.
It addresses issues like agent drift and incorrect assumptions by having a model write prompts and a human review them.
The framework includes features like defined routes for tasks and a review discipline with concrete failure scenarios.
caption:
Can AI coding be error-free? A new framework uses Claude to improve efficiency.

The framework helps reduce manual steps in AI coding, improving quality and speed.

It addresses issues like agent drift and incorrect assumptions by having a model write prompts and a human review them.

The framework includes features like defined routes for tasks and a review discipline with concrete failure scenarios.

headline_marked: China's AI Models Save 90% on OpenAI Costs [[DeepSeek V4 Flash]]
headline: China's AI Models Save 90% on OpenAI Costs DeepSeek V4 Flash
summary: A developer tested China's top 4 AI models to reduce OpenAI costs. DeepSeek V4 Flash offers comparable quality at 1/10th the price.
details: The developer was spending $84 weekly on OpenAI API calls, prompting a search for cheaper alternatives. They tested DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, and GLM models.
DeepSeek's V4 Flash model performed well on English tasks, especially code generation and speed, at $0.25 per million output tokens.
The developer now uses DeepSeek V4 Flash for English work, saving $0.30-$0.40 per task. Qwen's smaller models also showed promising results.
The Chinese models support OpenAI-compatible APIs, making integration easy for the developer.
caption:
Can China's AI models really save you 90% on OpenAI costs?

The developer was spending $84 weekly on OpenAI API calls, prompting a search for cheaper alternatives. They tested DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, and GLM models.

DeepSeek's V4 Flash model performed well on English tasks, especially code generation and speed, at $0.25 per million output tokens.

The developer now uses DeepSeek V4 Flash for English work, saving $0.30-$0.40 per task. Qwen's smaller models also showed promising results.

The Chinese models support OpenAI-compatible APIs, making integration easy for the developer.
